channel.title: Sierra Leone - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Sierra Leone, every source cited.

item.title: Sierra Leone charcoal burning causes deforestation
item.description: Environmental Protection Agency notes economic trees are cut, leaving land exposed to climate change.

item.title: African nations face youth protests amid economic woes
item.description: Growth held steady at 3.8-4.1% in 2025, but citizens saw deepening political dissatisfaction and escalating conflicts.

item.title: Sierra Leone vice presidents fail to win presidency
item.description: No vice president has ever been elected president in Sierra Leone since independence.

item.title: Female artisanal miners report sexual violence in Kono district
item.description: Women working in the diamond-rich pits of Jaiama Nimikor describe incidents of rape and harassment while scavenging for gold and diamonds.

item.title: WAEC withholds 78-year-old candidate's exam result
item.description: Pa Lamin Turay's 2026 WASSCE result is among 47,454 withheld over suspected malpractice.
